entities.name: Ayli
entities.description: Female Kor cleric from Zendikar, high priest of the Eternal Pilgrims, formerly a follower of Kamsa.

entities.name: Eternal Pilgrims
entities.description: Kor group who tried to sacrifice Jace and Jori En.

entities.name: Radrik
entities.description: Ayli's older brother who left to join an expedition to Jwar Isle.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: Approaching titan the Pilgrims sought to sacrifice to.

events.summary: Radrik, envious of his sister, stops traveling with Ayli and joins an expedition to Jwar Isle.
events.quote: Radrik stopped traveling with his sister and joined up with an expedition to Jwar Isle.

events.summary: Ayli saves Jace and Jori En from Eldrazi spawn and brings them to the Eternal Pilgrims.
events.quote: Ayli saved Jace Beleren and Jori En from a pursuing swarm of Eldrazi spawn

events.summary: The Pilgrims try to chain Jace and Jori En as a sacrifice to Ulamog; they flee after Jace casts illusionary flames.
events.quote: Jace and Jori En fled after Jace cast illusionary flames on the Eternal Pilgrims.

events.summary: Ayli survives the Battle of Zendikar and searches for a new deity after Ulamog's demise.
events.quote: Ayli survived the Battle of Zendikar and the fall of the Titans

relations.quote: high priest of the Eternal Pilgrims
Ayli and her older brother Radrik
Formerly, she was a follower of Kamsa .
